entries.title: Servicios de SG Solutions
entries.content: SG Solutions ofrece servicios de asesoria crediticia, impuestos, formacion de negocio, financiamiento, preparacion de prestamos y asistencia para compra de vivienda. No incluye aprobaciones garantizadas ni pagos automaticos.

entries.title: SG Solutions Services
entries.content: SG Solutions provides credit education and readiness support, tax preparation and consultation, business formation guidance, business funding preparation, loan preparation, and home-buying support.

entries.title: Politica de precios
entries.content: Los precios dependen de la necesidad y el servicio. Si no hay precio publicado, se recomienda agendar consulta y revisar cada caso con un agente.

entries.title: Pricing policy
entries.content: Pricing depends on the requested package and case complexity. If no published amount exists, route to an appointment.

entries.title: Escalacion a humano
entries.content: Cuando la consulta requiere revision humana, disputa, error tecnico repetido o solicitud sensible, escala el caso a un agente.

entries.title: Human escalation
entries.content: Escalate to a human rep when sensitive legal/tax interpretation is required, low confidence, complaint, anger escalation, or repeated tool failure.

entries.title: Agendamiento
entries.content: Antes de confirmar una cita valida servicio, nombre, email, timezone y disponibilidad real. Nunca confirmes sin respuesta positiva del sistema de calendario.

entries.title: Booking
entries.content: Before confirming an appointment validate service, name, email, timezone and real availability. Never confirm until calendar API returns confirmation.
